name: The Pirate's Fate
source:
Mila wakes up among the Dread Pirates, who aren't what they seem. When she joins them on a high-stakes treasure hunt, she begins to transform based on your choices, following branching paths and multiple endings

In The Pirate’s Fate, Mila and the Dread Pirates hunt for magical treasure. You’ll navigate stormy seas, seedy saloons and monstrous coves in search of loot. And be warned: you aren’t the only pirates seeking this treasure!

Throughout the course of the game, Mila, other characters, and the story itself will change based on your moral choices. What will be your fate?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/553480/The_Pirates_Fate]Steam[/url]]
